title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3, 3.4 Motion in Space: Describe the velocity and acceleration vectors of a particle moving in space.
summary: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3, 3.4 Motion in Space: Describe the velocity and acceleration vectors of a particle moving in space.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3, section "3.4 Motion in Space", prints these objectives: "Describe the velocity and acceleration vectors of a particle moving in space." "Explain the tangential and normal components of acceleration." "State Kepler’s laws of planetary motion.". The section text says: "We have now seen how to describe curves in the plane and in space, and how to determine their properties, such as arc length and curvature. All of this leads to the main goal of this chapter, which is the description of motion along plane curves and space curves. We now have all the tools we need; in this section, we put these ideas together and look at how to use them." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
